+
+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger tests SQL Server database connections.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects and logs in to SQL Server through the local database tunnel.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	connector.Dialer = sqlServerDialer{ctx: ctx}
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	defer conn.Close()
+	return nil
+}
+
+// sqlServerDialer closes the socket when the test context expires, including
+// during the SQL Server login handshake.
+type sqlServerDialer struct {
+	ctx context.Context
+}
+
+func (d sqlServerDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, address)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	c := &sqlServerConn{Conn: conn}
+	c.stop = context.AfterFunc(d.ctx, func() { _ = c.Close() })
+	return c, nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerConn struct {
+	net.Conn
+	stop func() bool
+}
+
+func (c *sqlServerConn) Close() error {
+	if c.stop != nil {
+		c.stop()
+	}
+	return c.Conn.Close()
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports whether the SQL Server endpoint refused a connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) ||
+		errors.Is(err, syscall.EHOSTUNREACH) ||
+		errors.Is(err, syscall.ENETUNREACH) ||
+		(err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused"))
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports SQL Server login failures.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	var dbErr mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &dbErr) {
+		return dbErr.Number == 18456 || dbErr.Number == 18452
+	}
+	return err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "login failed for user")
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports unknown or inaccessible SQL Server databases.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	var dbErr mssql.Error
+	if errors.As(err, &dbErr) {
+		return dbErr.Number == 4060 || dbErr.Number == 911 || dbErr.Number == 916
+	}
+	return err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "cannot open database")
+}

+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"strconv"
+	"syscall"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/common"
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/srv/db/sqlserver"
+)
+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	testServer, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{AuthClient: setupMockClient(t)})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() { _ = testServer.Serve() }()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, testServer.Close()) })
+
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(testServer.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, params))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingValidationAndDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	p := &SQLServerPinger{}
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}
+	for _, invalid := range []PingParams{
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, DatabaseName: "somedb"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "someuser"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"},
+		{Host: "localhost", Port: -1, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"},
+	} {
+		require.Error(t, p.Ping(context.Background(), invalid))
+	}
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.Error(t, p.Ping(ctx, params))
+
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer listener.Close()
+	port := listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
+	ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	params.Port = port
+	start := time.Now()
+	require.Error(t, p.Ping(ctx, params))
+	require.Less(t, time.Since(start), time.Second)
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerErrorCategories(t *testing.T) {
+	p := &SQLServerPinger{}
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		err               error
+		refused, user, db bool
+	}{
+		{err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.ECONNREFUSED), refused: true},
+		{err: fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.EHOSTUNREACH), refused: true},
+		{err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 18456, Message: "login failed"}), user: true},
+		{err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 4060, Message: "database not found"}), db: true},
+		{err: trace.Wrap(mssql.Error{Number: 911}), db: true},
+		{err: errors.New("unrelated")},
+		{err: nil},
+	} {
+		require.Equal(t, tc.refused, p.IsConnectionRefusedError(tc.err))
+		require.Equal(t, tc.user, p.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tc.err))
+		require.Equal(t, tc.db, p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tc.err))
+	}
+}
